name: Oningyou Gokko -Convenient hole-
source:
This is a game about a dark relationship with Sanae, a girl who willingly accepts the hardcore sexual acts.
"Even in the daylight hours, there's always someone standing in front of the bookshelf full of maniac books.however, the person I found today there was very special..."

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE058674.html]DLsite english[/url]]
